{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique sites
sites = data['site'].unique()
print(f'Unique sites in data: {sorted(sites)}')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]
print(f'Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
n_neg999 = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {n_neg999}')

# Check assay_batch unit issue
print(f'Assay batch A: {data[data["assay_batch"] == "A"]["biomarker_final"].describe()}')
print(f'Assay batch B: {data[data["assay_batch"] == "B"]["biomarker_final"].describe()}')"}
